baslik: Is the couple in American Gothic really married? 🤔 #shorts
aciklama:
Grant Wood's sister Nan and his 62-year-old dentist posed separately for American Gothic (1930). The papers called them a farmer and his wife. Nan said father and daughter.

What do you think? Tell me in the comments 👇
